etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Borrowed from French atavisme.. By surface analysis, at- (“to”) +‎ Latin av(us) (“grandfather, ancestor”) +‎ -ism. Compare ancestorism.
senses: The reappearance of an ancestral characteristic in an organism after several generations of absence; a throwback.
The recurrence or reversion to a past behaviour, method, characteristic or style after a long period of absence.
